stories.headline: US inflation rises more than expected ahead of midterm elections
stories.description: The pace of price rises increased to 3.7% in the year to September, driving by higher motor fuel costs.

stories.headline: Iraq’s PM tells Saudi crown prince Iraqi territory will not be used for attacks
stories.description: Saudi Arabia’s East-West oil pipeline was struck by drones last month in an attack that originated in Iraq.

stories.headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi missile launched towards Riyadh
stories.description: Saudi civil defence authority says danger passed after it issued alerts via its national early warning platform.

stories.headline: Iran steps up Hormuz surveillance: Attacks soar, oil flows crash again
stories.description: Ships in the Strait of Hormuz have been experiencing the worst spate of attacks since the start of the war.

stories.headline: Russia’s arrest of Japanese journalist: Why are tensions rising?
stories.description: Japanese journalist Imai Yuki arrested on Sakhalin for allegedly spying on Russian defence capabilities, says the FSB.
